description: Full-text search over the entire HackerNews history ranked by relevance — covers 20+ years of tech stories, Ask HN threads, Show HN posts, and job listings. Returns title, URL, author, score, comment count, and submission time. Supports filtering by type (story/ask/show/job/poll). Powered by Algolia. No auth required. Data: Hacker News (CC BY 3.0).

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–30, default 10).

query.description: Full-text search query. Searches across HN story titles, URLs, and authors. Supports multi-word queries (e.g. "rust programming language", "openai gpt").

type.description: Content type filter. "story" = submitted links; "ask" = Ask HN threads; "show" = Show HN posts; "job" = job listings; "poll" = polls. Default: story.

name: hnalgolia.search.relevance

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: HN Algolia Search (Relevance)
